text:
Sam: midday standup — quick check: what does fleet headroom look like across regions? any quota or provisioning blockers?

Elle: eu-west-2: did a targeted prewarm at 09:30, added 6 GPUs to non-prod pool. spot eviction jumped to ~8% last hour so effective headroom is thin for low-priority. opened INF-4627 for a quota bump (requested +24 GPUs). pinged acct rep. :handshake:

Kai: us-west-2 currently has ~14 spare GPUs after the morning drains. I can re-route a couple of non-prod jobs there if we need immediate capacity.

infra-bot: autoscaler: scaled up 8 nodes in eu-west-2 at 12:12Z (policy: prewarm-high). avg spin-up 42s.

Marta: blocker: running a 2pm perf run requires 20 spare GPUs in us-west-2 for 45m. if we can't guarantee that, we should postpone. raising an ops ticket now.

Sam: understood. @Kai can you reserve 20 for the 14:00 window? if reservation not possible, let's at least cordon nodes so autoscaler doesn't reclaim them. I'm going to attach the perf matrix to the ticket.

Kai: on it — trying a soft-reservation via capacity-pools; command I'm running: `./infractl allocate --region us-west-2 --count 20 --ttl 60m --pool nonprod-temporary` (will report status).

Elle: opened a support case with partner for eu-west-2 quota uplift and asked for expedited review. case #SUP-8891. put the perf numbers and timeline in the case.

Sam: FYI, long-term ask: we should formalize a regional fallback policy in the runbook — move non-critical workloads to us-west-2 or ap-southeast-1 during spot instability. drafting a PR for runbook updates.

Kai: quick note re: billing/quotas — if we shift non-prod cross-region we should toggle the cost alerts. I can add a temporary alert rule: `cost-alert --scope nonprod --threshold 20%` so finance sees the delta.

Marta: also hitting a minor blocker with the provisioning script — PR #789 needs a quick CR. test failing on concurrency flag for `provision_gpu_pool`. Sam, can you take a look? it's small.

Sam: will review in 15. if it's urgent ping me in threads.

Elle: one more: eu-central-1 has available capacity but quota is fragmented across AZs (we have quota in a and c but not b). asked partner to consolidate or to grant cross-AZ placement permissions.

infra-bot: quota-monitor: eu-central-1: a=18, b=2, c=0 — fragmentation alert triggered 12:55Z.

Kai: plan: if partner can't consolidate, we'll prefer placement strategy that balances across a/c and avoid b. I can add a placement policy change to the provisioner for the short term.

Sam: action items: 
- Kai: try the soft reservation for us-west-2 and report by 12:45Z.
- Elle: update support case SUP-8891 with perf numbers and ask for cross-AZ consolidation in eu-central-1.
- Marta: document the 2pm perf run requirement in the ops ticket and include rollback plan.
- Sam: draft runbook PR for regional fallback and review PR #789.

Marta: noted. I'll also leave a quick note in the perf channel so product knows we might postpone. :spiral_calendar:

Sam: thanks all — small ask: if anyone sees the autoscaler start reclaiming nodes during the 13:40–14:30 window, @sam will suspend scale-in and DM infra oncall.

Kai: update — soft reservation succeeded, allocated 20 in us-west-2, id=alloc-2026-03-17-01. will tag nodes and cordon once they land.

Elle: support replied: partner is routing to quota team, expected reply ~4–6 hours. flagged as high priority.

Sam: great. closing the loop here — I'll post a brief summary after the 2pm run. :white_check_mark:
